roadmap.title: Normal playthrough
roadmap.description: Play all ten memories on Normal (the only selectable difficulty) and take the no-kill path: use non-lethal takedowns only and never leave a death to a trap or falling debris. The story, speed, smoke, pickpocket, takedown, style, and combo achievements fall into place along the way.

roadmap.title: Plus Hard unseen run
roadmap.description: Beating Normal unlocks Plus and Plus Hard. Start Plus Hard and finish every memory without being seen once, replaying any memory where you are spotted. Keep the no-kill rules and use Eagle Vision to read the hidden vision cones. This finishes the two mastery achievements and banks Shadow and Silencer gold ratings.

roadmap.title: Grind and cleanup
roadmap.description: Replay memories and checkpoints to finish the cumulative counters: multi-kills, Helix Blade kills, Helix Blend passes, and the remaining gold style ratings.

steps.text: Play through @loc{Memory Sequence 1}; it is part of the story and cannot be missed.
Play from @loc{Memory Sequence 1} through the final memory; the achievement unlocks after the closing cutscene.

achievements.description: Complete Assassin's Creed® Chronicles: India without killing anyone.
achievements.summary: Finish the story without killing any enemy.

guide.context: Only kills you cause count: non-lethal takedowns are always safe, and the scripted fights in memories 3, 8, 9, and 10 are exempt, but a guard left to die in a trap or under falling debris still counts. Each memory is judged on its own, so one finished with a kill can be replayed clean.

steps.text: Hold the takedown button to knock guards out non-lethally instead of killing them.
In memories 4 and 5, take guards out yourself rather than letting trap panels or falling rocks kill them.
If a memory ends with a kill, replay that memory and keep it clean; the achievement unlocks once all ten are recorded without a kill.

achievements.description: Complete Assassin's Creed® Chronicles: India in Plus Hard mode without being seen once.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Plus Hard without ever being seen.

guide.context: Plus Hard unlocks when the story is finished on Normal, and it hides all vision cones unless Eagle Vision is on. Kills are allowed — a guard reacting to a body is not a detection — while scripted ambush sightings are exempt. Each memory is tracked separately, so a spotted memory can be replayed unseen.

steps.text: After finishing the story on Normal, start a new playthrough on @mechanic{Plus Hard}.
Switch on @mechanic{Eagle Vision} whenever guards are near; without it, their vision cones stay hidden.
Restart the checkpoint the moment a guard sees you, or whenever you are unsure.
steps.note: On a regular memory, a gold style rating at the checkpoint confirms you were not seen. In the Memory 8 mortar section, shoot each guard fast so nobody finds a body.

steps.text: Replay any memory that was spotted and finish it unseen; the achievement unlocks after the final memory.

achievements.description: Pickpocket or Loot 100 enemies without being seen.
achievements.summary: Steal from or loot 100 enemies while staying unseen.

guide.context: @mechanic{Eagle Vision} marks which guards are carrying valuables. If your item slots are full, loot a corpse or spend items to free space.

steps.text: Sneak up behind a guard and pickpocket him, or take him down and loot the body.
steps.note: Both pickpockets and body loots count; repeat until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Use the Smoke to pass by 100 enemies.
achievements.summary: Use smoke bombs to slip past 100 enemies.

guide.context: Smoke bombs are introduced in @loc{Memory Sequence 2}. Every guard you move past while the smoke is up counts.

steps.text: Throw a @item{smoke bomb} into a group of guards and walk past them while they are blinded.
To finish faster, replay the @loc{Memory Sequence 2} section where smoke bombs are first granted: smoke the guards, take them down, then restart the checkpoint.

achievements.summary: Kill 200 enemies with multi-kill takedowns, two at a time.

guide.context: A multi-kill prompt (skull icon) appears when two guards stand close together; it works from a ledge above them or from behind one of the pair. The counter needs 100 multi-kills in total.

steps.text: At the end of @loc{Memory Sequence 6}, reach the room where ten guards must be eliminated and find the two guards standing together in the middle.
Drop on them from the ceiling or sneak up behind one of the pair, then use the multi-kill prompt to take out both at once.
Restart the checkpoint and repeat until the counter reaches 200 enemies.
steps.note: The pair of conversing guards at the end of @loc{Memory Sequence 2} is an earlier alternative.

steps.text: Take down enemies as you play; both lethal and non-lethal takedowns count.
steps.note: The counter carries across playthroughs and chapter replays.

achievements.description: Have 100 enemies pass by you whilst using Helix Blend.
achievements.summary: Let 100 guards walk past while you are hidden by Helix Blend.

guide.context: @mechanic{Helix Blend} is taught in @loc{Memory Sequence 8} of a first playthrough. The farm below uses it in @loc{Memory Sequence 7}, which is only possible on a @mechanic{Plus} run.

steps.text: Finish the story to unlock @mechanic{Plus mode}, then replay @loc{Memory Sequence 7} and collect the purple @item{Helix Boosts} on the way to the first checkpoint.
After the first checkpoint, jump down in front of the door and press Y (Xbox) or Triangle (PS4) to blend into the background just before four guards walk out.
Stay blended while all four guards pass you, then restart the checkpoint and repeat until the counter reaches 100.

achievements.description: Dispose of 100 enemies using Helix Blade.
achievements.summary: Make 100 enemies vanish with Helix Blade takedowns.

guide.context: @mechanic{Helix Blade} unlocks only after the story is completed. Triggered on an unaware enemy, it disposes of the body in smoke and loots it automatically.

steps.text: Replay @loc{Memory Sequence 3} on a @mechanic{Plus} run and pick up the purple @item{Helix Boost} at the start.
Smoke bomb the first two guards, start an assassination, and mash Y (Xbox) or Triangle (PS4) during the takedown to erase the body.
Restart the checkpoint and repeat until 100 enemies have been disposed of.

achievements.description: Achieve Shadow Gold Style rating 30 times.
achievements.summary: Finish 30 sections with a gold Shadow style rating.

guide.context: A style rating is awarded at each checkpoint. Shadow Gold requires clearing the section unseen and without touching any enemy. The revert trick below repeats a single rating quickly.

steps.text: Play @loc{Memory Sequence 2} to the spot where you crouch under the path next to the ammo crate, where a checkpoint and a rating are awarded.
Revert to the last checkpoint: it restarts you just before the rating, so walk forward and take the rating again.
Repeat the revert until the achievement unlocks.
steps.note: The same loop works for any other style rating you still need.

achievements.description: Achieve Assassin Gold Style rating 30 times.

guide.context: Assassin Gold is awarded for a section cleared with at least one lethal takedown and no alerts.

steps.text: Use the @loc{Memory Sequence 2} checkpoint by the ammo crate: kill a guard in the final stretch and stay unseen so the rating comes out Assassin Gold.
Revert the checkpoint to restart just before the rating and take it again.
Repeat until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Achieve Silencer Gold Style rating 30 times.

guide.context: Silencer Gold needs a section where every takedown is non-lethal and no alarm is raised. Hold the takedown button to knock the guard out instead of killing him.

steps.text: Use the @loc{Memory Sequence 2} checkpoint by the ammo crate: knock a guard out non-lethally in the final stretch so the rating comes out Silencer Gold.
Revert the checkpoint to restart just before the rating and take it again.
Repeat until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum score multiplier in any memory sequence and maintain it for two more sections.
achievements.summary: Build the score multiplier to its maximum and hold it for two more sections.

guide.context: Gold style ratings raise the score multiplier; a run of them reaches the maximum, and the next two sections must also stay gold. Staying unseen and never touching a guard makes @loc{Memory Sequence 1} a reliable place for it.

steps.text: Play @loc{Memory Sequence 1} unseen and without touching any enemy, keeping the gold ratings going through the following sections until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: In Memory Sequence 3, rescue Hamid in under 5 minutes.
achievements.summary: Reach Hamid atop the building in Memory Sequence 3 and rescue him within 5 minutes.

guide.context: Reach Hamid and free him within 5 minutes; skip collectibles and side objectives and keep alarms off on the way up.

steps.text: Head straight to the top of the building and rescue Hamid without detours.
steps.note: After the rescue, the memory continues with a separate chase timer; keep moving and ignore optional pickups there too.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 4 in under 9 minutes.
achievements.summary: Finish Memory Sequence 4 in less than 9 minutes.

guide.context: A clean run takes about 8 minutes, so there is a little room for error. Restarting a checkpoint costs no time, so revert instead of replaying the whole memory.

steps.text: Run and jump everywhere instead of walking; in climbing sections press A (Xbox) or X (PS4) to move faster.
Skip guards by throwing a @item{smoke bomb} and running past them under the smoke.
steps.note: If you are not protecting the no-kill achievement, killing a blocker with a sliding assassination after the smoke is faster.

steps.text: Ignore @item{Animus fragments} and optional objectives.
If a section goes badly, restart the checkpoint; the restart adds no time.

achievements.description: Clear the Mortar Guards in Memory Sequence 8 without taking any damage.
achievements.summary: Shoot all five mortar guards at the end of Memory Sequence 8 without taking a hit.

guide.context: The sniper rifle is picked up automatically at the end of the memory. A mortar hit ruins the attempt, but restarting the checkpoint resets it.

steps.text: After climbing the tower, switch on @mechanic{Eagle Vision} to spot each guard as he runs to a mortar.
Wait until the guard reaches the mortar and stands still, then shoot him; headshots are not needed.
Clear them in the order they appear: one from the far right, one from the left, then two from the back left and one from the back right.
Restart the checkpoint immediately if a mortar damages you.

achievements.description: Complete Memory Sequence 9 in under 7 minutes.
achievements.summary: Beat the 7-minute time limit on Memory Sequence 9.

guide.context: The gold time for this memory is 6 minutes and under, so the 7-minute target leaves about a minute of margin, and cutscenes do not count toward the timer.

steps.text: Keep moving through the chase and jump instead of running to gain time.
Kill the guards in your path without slowing down; these kills do not void the no-kill achievement.
steps.note: If you would rather not kill a blocking guard, throw a smoke bomb while running and he steps aside.

steps.text: For the boss at the end, bait out his pistol, dodge the three shots, then strike and mash the kill prompt.
steps.note: If he hides in the crowd and burns time, restart the checkpoint to redo just the fight.
